name: Macadamia nut oil
description: Macadamia nut oil (CAS 438545-25-6 ) is a premium plant-derived oil pressed from the kernels of Macadamia integrifolia or M. tetraphylla. It functions as a moisturizing agent, emollient, and lubricant across food, personal care, and industrial formulation markets. In personal care, it is used as a skin-conditioning base in facial oils, lip balms, hair serums, and massage products. Its dry, non-greasy skin feel supports premium positioning for high-end cosmetic brands and dermatological applications. Food manufacturers incorporate it as a specialty culinary oil and functional ingredient in dressings, confectionery coatings, and nutritional supplements. It provides a stable profile for various food processing requirements and flavor enhancement. In coatings and adhesives, it serves as a bio-based plasticizing or lubricating component where renewable raw material sourcing is a requirement. This makes it an ideal choice for companies focusing on sustainable chemical alternatives. Contract formulators also use it as a carrier oil in encapsulation and delivery systems for active ingredients. Its high stability and compatibility with other lipids make it a versatile medium for complex chemical formulations. The oil is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid. Standard grades include food-grade ( FCC -compliant), cosmetic-grade, and cold-pressed variants, with refined and unrefined options available depending on specific application needs. Bulk supply is typically offered in drums and intermediate bulk containers (IBCs) to meet industrial demand.
